back: A brief, formal internal message within an organisation.
MEMORANDUM → To, From (with title), Date, Subject → purpose → numbered points → action required → initials.

front: Does a memo have a salutation or complimentary close?
back: No. The heading block replaces them; the memo ends with initials.
The part of a memo that tells readers exactly what to do and by when.
Please note that…; With effect from…; All staff are requested to…; Kindly submit … by …
Brief, direct, polite, logically ordered; numbered points for several instructions.
Memo: internal, heading block, initials. Letter: external, addresses, salutation, Yours faithfully/sincerely.
